about: How Hooke shows what the models made, and knows where everything is (the live partner spec 4.8, horizontal 2; Will, 29 Oct: "HOW we display in various ways the data produced by the models is critical and not an afterthought at all"), in his words on the real June 14 leaf recording: every cell outlined, their results in a Tab of their own (the outlines on their capture and their table, like his "Cell outlines" Tab), the table moved beside the live view, the outlines as an overlay on the live view, which Tab has the measurements (read from what each Tab holds, never its title), a YouTube video about stomata in a window with its source said, and only the video left open in the Tab. Each place is said as the screen shows it ("in the Cell results Tab, beside the table"); any internal language spoken fails a step (standard LEAK_PHRASES). Played as the camera; no setup.

expect.visible: the leaf epidermis cells outlined as a layer on the live view
expect.judge: outlines the cells on the live view and says how many, once

steps.say: Open the cell results in a new tab.

expect.visible: a new Tab in front holding the cells' outlines on their capture and their measurements table side by side, with no live view in it
expect.judge: makes a new Tab holding the outlines on their capture and their table side by side, names the Tab, and says where each is; claims nothing the screen does not show

steps.say: Now put the table beside the live view instead.

expect.visible: the measurements table on Main beside the live view, side by side, and no longer in the results Tab
expect.judge: moves the table to the Tab with the live view and puts the two side by side, saying where it is now (on Main, beside the live view)

steps.say: Show the outlines as an overlay on the live view.

expect.visible: the cells' outlines drawn on the live view
expect.judge: draws the cells' outlines on the live view (not in a window) and says so once

steps.say: Switch to the cell results tab.

expect.visible: the Cell results Tab in front
expect.judge: brings the Cell results Tab to the front and says so in a few words

steps.say: Which tab has the measurements? Open it.

expect.visible: Main, the Tab holding the measurements table, in front
expect.judge: names Main as the Tab that holds the table (it was moved there; Cell results, in front, now holds only the outlines) from what the Tabs hold, never from a Tab's title, and brings Main to the front

steps.say: Find a YouTube video about stomata and open it.

expect.visible: a YouTube video about stomata playing in a window in front, its source and link shown
expect.judge: finds a real YouTube video about stomata and opens it in a window, saying its title and that it is from YouTube; never claims a video that is not shown

steps.say: Only have the video open in this tab and close everything else.

expect.visible: only the video open in the Tab; the table closed; on Main the live view small in its corner
expect.judge: leaves only the video open in the Tab, closing the rest, says plainly what is left (on Main the live view stays, small), and never asks the user to ask again
